Assistant A’s answer is incorrect: it requires the arrays to be the same length, sorts already-sorted arrays, uses O(n log n) time, and does not correctly compute the median of two sorted arrays of different sizes.

Assistant B provides a correct and efficient binary-search solution for finding the median of two sorted arrays with O(1) space, though it incorrectly claims the requested O(n) time / O(1) space solution is impossible. Despite that flaw, its implementation is substantially more relevant and correct than Assistant A’s.

[[B]]
